scheduleNotes.body: Arrival 7:45–7:57am ET; dismissal 3:30pm. No supervision before 7:45. Late arrivals must be walked into the main office and signed in (no curb drop-off). Dismissal cars should not arrive before 3:15pm. All parking-lot exits are right turn only. Child released only to Blackbaud Emergency Contacts.
